validation.currency_needs_lines: The currency can only be changed together with the order lines
validation.invalid_discount: Invalid discount: percent must be between 0 and 100, amount must be positive
validation.discount_needs_lines: The order discount can only be changed together with the order lines
validation.invalid_component_units: Invalid number of units for a bundle component

error.no_lines: An order must have at least one line
error.invalid_line: Variant #{{variant_id}} does not exist or does not belong to the product on the same line
error.invalid_option: A chosen option on variant #{{variant_id}} does not belong to its product
error.option_selection: Variant #{{variant_id}}: a question on the product needs between {{min}} and {{max}} answers
error.lines_locked: Only a pending order can have its lines changed
error.lines_invoiced: The order has been invoiced; cancel or credit its invoice before changing the lines
error.lines_missing: The order has no lines to take its currency from
error.exchange_rate_unavailable: No exchange rate is available for {{currency}}; add one or wait for the daily import
error.discount_not_allowed: You do not have permission to apply discounts to an order
error.not_a_bundle: Variant #{{variant_id}} is not a bundle, so it takes no components
error.bundle_empty: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}} has no components to explode into
error.bundle_changed: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}} has changed in the catalog; pick its components again
error.bundle_component_invalid: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: a chosen component does not belong to this bundle
error.bundle_component_included: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: that component already comes with the bundle and cannot be chosen separately
error.bundle_group_unanswered: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: one of its choices has not been answered
error.bundle_group_multiple: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: a bundle choice takes exactly one option
error.bundle_component_ceiling: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: that component may be taken at most {{max}} times
error.bundle_discount: Bundle variant #{{variant_id}}: a typed discount is not offered on a bundle line; use the order discount
error.client_locked: The order is already invoiced or has a payment under its client; reverse or cancel those before moving it to another client
error.billing_locked: The order has been invoiced; its billing details were frozen on the invoice - reverse or cancel it before changing them
error.billing_country_unknown: No country is recorded under the code {{code}}

history.deleted: Order(s) {{entity_ids}} marked as deleted by user #{{auth_id}}
history.status: Order #{{entity_id}} updated from {{oldStatus}} to {{newStatus}} by user #{{auth_id}}
